finding.mechanism: The SFT generator emits cognition intrinsics including state_note, focus_set, self_kind, policy_select, recovery_state and provenance while the original cognition spec did not define a closed intrinsic vocabulary. The structural validator checked punctuation/envelope/omega gates but did not reject unknown intrinsics or wrong arity. Therefore corpus validation and OOD promotion could credit outputs that contradict the spec invariant that unknown intrinsics fail closed.
finding.counterhypothesis: The extra calls are harmless descriptive pseudo-code and do not need formal admission semantics.
finding.counterhypothesis_result: REJECTED_FOR_TRAINING_CONTRACT: the owner target is ClayCode-only cognition with deterministic grammar/type/schema/authority/generation admission, so undefined calls cannot be treated as valid training targets without creating a weight/runtime semantic split.

unusual_experiment.result: The first parser revision falsely counted cfg("entity.id") as arity zero because string payload masking erased the literal token. The parser was repaired to preserve a passive literal placeholder; representative valid calls then matched expected arity, while an injected unknown intrinsic and a wrong-arity focus_set were rejected.
